title: Wikipedia co-founder: I no longer trust the website I created
summary: UnHerd interviews Wikipedia co-founder Larry Sanger, who explains why he no longer trusts the site he helped create. He argues that it has become biased and is no longer a neutral, open platform.
why: HN commenters cite it as an authoritative-sounding critique of Wikipedia's bias, coming from one of its own founders.

quote.text: I suggest you watch this interview with Wikipedia co-founder Larry Sanger on why you shouldn't trust Wikipedia.
